entry.note: Confirmed paper is 'Higher-Dimensional Algebra V: 2-Groups' by John C. Baez (arXiv:math/0307200). emergence-to-quantum-flat.lean:34 cites it for INN(G_q) being 'the unique strict 2-group' under simplicity constraint — this paper IS the canonical 2-groups reference; INN construction is in the body.

relevance.rationale: Join CORRECT (arXiv:math/0307200v3, matching the registered entry). Not in the working tree on this branch; recovered from intake commit 4009ba4f91, sha matches. The paper is a detailed treatment of weak/coherent 2-groups and their classification by Postnikov data. MISCITED at its principal site: folio/quantum-observable-universe/quantum-observable-universes/emergence-to-quantum-flat.lean:36,63 cites [baez2004] for a structure whose docstring asserts 'The quantum flatness condition F_A = B is equivalent to the instanton equation F_A^- = 0 under the simplicity constraint. The 2-group INN(G_q) is the unique strict 2-group for which this equivalence holds.' Searching the full text of this document for 'INN(', 'inner automorphism 2-group', 'fake curvature', 'fake flat', 'instanton', 'simplicity constraint', 'BF theory', 'F_A' returns exactly one hit, and it is about Aut_s(H), the strict automorphism 2-group, in a purely algebraic classification context. The document contains no connections, no curvature, no BF/spin-foam content, and no INN(G) construction. The other two sites (appendix-standard-model/sm-gauge-truncation.lean:30 and gauge-action-groupoid.lean:33) list it in a References block with no claim attached; sm-gauge-truncation is about an SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1) embedding, which this document does not address. The right source is already registered and sitting uncited: baez-schreiber2007 (library/arxiv-math-0511710v2/0511710v2.pdf) is the paper that defines 2-connections on principal 2-bundles and states the vanishing-fake-curvature condition (its abstract line 27; body lines 473, 1559, 1566, 1568). Scope-(a): this document, as read, does not support the F=B / instanton / INN(G_q) uniqueness claim it is cited for.

proposedActions.rationale: Replace or supplement the [baez2004] citation on the quantum-flatness/fake-curvature claim with [baez-schreiber2007], which actually contains the 2-connection and vanishing-fake-curvature material; keep [baez2004] only where 2-group structure per se is invoked.

The 'INN(G_q) is the unique strict 2-group for which this equivalence holds' uniqueness claim carries no source that supports it. Record what would need checking: which strict 2-groups admit the F=B <-> F^- = 0 equivalence under the simplicity constraint, and where that uniqueness is proved.
